business_summary: Highbroad Advanced Material (Hefei) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of backlight display modules and core components in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers thin-film transistor liquid crystal display (TFT-LCD) and Mini-LED backlight display modules; reflectors; diffusion and prism sheets; Mini-LED light panels; lamp board driver design; streaming media rearview mirror design; light guide plates; precision structural parts; optical materials; and other related components. It also provides optoelectronic display thin-film devices, including polarizers, optical films, and adhesive tapes for optoelectronic displays; OLED open mask recycling and manufacturing services; optical engines and light sources for liquid crystal displays; display equipment accessories; electronic and electrical components; molds; and electronic parts materials, as well as professional, technical, and business services. The company's products are used in various applications, including laptops, tablets, desktop displays, automotive displays, medical displays, industrial control displays, and VR devices. It exports its products. Highbroad Advanced Material (Hefei) Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Hefei, the People's Republic of China.
